characters.summary: Dwayne Hicks is a disciplined and experienced Colonial Marine corporal who excels in tactical firearms combat, squad leadership, and survival under extreme pressure against xenomorph infestations.

mechanisms: Colonial Marine body armor and helmet

weaknesses: Vulnerable to acid blood upon close-range melee kills
Limited ammunition reserves in protracted engagements
limitations: Human physical limitations subject to injury and acid burns

sources.supports: Covers Hicks's role as a Colonial Marine corporal, weapon usage, and encounters with xenomorphs.

feats.claim: Successfully operates a motion tracker and coordinates defensive perimeters against swarming xenomorphs.
Survives initial operations in the Hadley's Hope colony and defends the survivors.

notableResults.note: Fought off multiple attacking aliens using pulse rifles and coordinated squad defense.

campaignTags.claim: Equipped with futuristic military weaponry, motion trackers, and Colonial Marine body armor.

unknowns: Exact fate or operational record outside the primary film continuity and official sequels.

characters.summary: Ellen Ripley is a resourceful survivor and tactical troubleshooter who overcomes relentless extraterrestrial threats through sheer tenacity, engineering ingenuity, and combat loader operation.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to biological trauma and xenomorph acid
Human physical fragility without heavy equipment
limitations: Equipment dependency for heavy combat advantages

sources.supports: Covers Ellen Ripley's encounters with xenomorphs, use of power loaders, and survival feats.

feats.claim: Pilots a P-5000 Work Loader to physically battle and defeat the Alien Queen.
Purges an entire xenomorph nest using an integrated flamethrower and pulse rifle.

notableResults.note: Fought using a heavy industrial power loader and ejected her into an airlock.

campaignTags.claim: Operates industrial power loaders and advanced futuristic weaponry.

unknowns: Clones and hybrid physiology variations introduced in later sequels.

characters.summary: Ethan Hunt is an elite IMF agent specializing in high-stakes infiltration, espionage, disguise manipulation, and extreme physical stunts to neutralize global security threats.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical harm and torture like any peak human
Dependence on IMF tech support and gadgets

sources.supports: Covers Ethan Hunt's background as an IMF agent, espionage skills, and stunt-based action feats.

feats.claim: Infiltrates the CIA headquarters by rappelling into a heavily monitored pressure-sensitive vault.
Climbs the exterior glass of the Burj Khalifa using specialized adhesive gloves.

notableResults.note: Defeated in hand-to-hand combat on a beach after a motorcycle chase.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes face-mask generators, climbing gloves, and specialized IMF espionage technology.
Specializes in covert infiltration of highly secure government and criminal facilities.
Performs undetected espionage entries into high-security vaults.

unknowns: Exact limits of IMF technological reserves during off-grid operations.

characters.summary: Evelyn Carnahan is an intelligent Egyptologist and librarian who uses her encyclopedic knowledge of ancient artifacts, languages, and occasional firearms to survive supernatural encounters.
weaknesses: Standard human physical vulnerability
Clumsy under direct melee pressure without prep
limitations: Physical combat relies entirely on basic firearms and defense
Spells require specific ancient texts and pronunciation

sources.supports: Covers Evelyn Carnahan's expertise in Egyptology, magical lore, and confrontations with mummies.

feats.claim: Recites passages from the Book of Amun-Ra to strip Imhotep of his immortal powers.
Unlocks ancient tombs and translates complex hieroglyphs under hazardous conditions.

notableResults.note: Fought in hand-to-hand combat utilizing past-life memories before the fight was interrupted.

conditional.dependsOn: Access to authentic ancient texts like the Book of Amun-Ra

campaignTags.claim: Reads and recites ancient Egyptian scrolls capable of affecting supernatural entities.

unknowns: Exact extent of her past-life combat abilities when awakened.

characters.summary: Gogo Yubari is a lethal teenage assassin serving O-Ren Ishii, utilizing a disguised meteor hammer and ruthless cunning to trap and destroy opponents in close quarters.

techniques: Meteor hammer (kusarigama-style chained steel ball with blade)

weaknesses: Prone to reckless overconfidence and sadism
Vulnerable if her chained weapon gets tangled or caught
limitations: Short range restricted by the length of her chain weapon

sources.supports: Covers Gogo Yubari's role as O-Ren Ishii's bodyguard and her fight with Beatrix Kiddo using a meteor hammer.

feats.claim: Effectively wields a meteor hammer in combat, hurling the weighted chain ball to wrap around opponents and obstacles.
Assassines businessman Tanaka prior to the House of Blue Leaves sequence.

notableResults.note: Killed during the House of Blue Leaves fight after getting her own chain wrapped around her neck.

unknowns: Complete backstory prior to joining the Crazy 88 Yakuza gang.

characters.summary: Gorgo is a massive prehistoric sea monster captured off the coast of Ireland, possessing colossal physical strength, structural devastation capabilities, and high resilience to conventional military weapons.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to capture via specialized electrical nets and heavy trapping equipment
Susceptible to targeted heavy artillery fire
limitations: Slow turning radius due to massive size

sources.supports: Covers Gorgo's status as a giant prehistoric monster captured in Ireland and rampaging through London.

feats.claim: Demolishes portions of central London including Piccadilly Circus during a rampage.
Resists standard military tank fire and small arms before being subdued by massed electrical cables.

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed tanks and troops in London before reuniting with its even larger mother.

campaignTags.claim: A towering prehistoric creature standing dozens of feet tall.
Natural aquatic creature originating from the ocean depths near Ireland.
Spends its life in the sea and breathes underwater.

unknowns: Exact biological origins beyond prehistoric monster lore.

characters.summary: Sir Guy of Gisborne is a ruthless and skilled Norman knight who serves the corrupt Sheriff of Nottingham, utilizing heavy broadsword combat and armored guards to enforce tyranny.

mechanisms: Full medieval plate armor and chainmail

weaknesses: Slowed down by heavy medieval armor
Arrogance and overreliance on brute force
limitations: Restricted mobility due to heavy medieval armor weight
Vulnerable to agile opponents in close quarters

sources.supports: Covers Sir Guy of Gisborne's role as the Sheriff's enforcer and his sword fights with Robin Hood.

feats.claim: Engages Robin Hood in an intense, extended sword duel inside Nottingham Castle.
Commands Norman soldiers to hunt down and suppress outlaws in Sherwood Forest.

notableResults.note: Defeated in a duel to the death by Robin Hood in the castle throne room.

unknowns: Performance in large-scale medieval warfare outside castle skirmishes.

characters.summary: Han Lue is a cool-headed, drift-racing specialist and tactician who combines exceptional vehicular control with precise firearms and cool under-fire composure.

mechanisms: Custom-tuned armored or roll-caged sports cars

weaknesses: Vulnerable while outside of his vehicle
Human physical limitations
limitations: Relies heavily on having a high-performance vehicle for peak tactical effectiveness

sources.supports: Covers Han's driving skills, involvement in the Fast & Furious crew, and tactical abilities.

feats.claim: Executes complex drift maneuvers through dense Tokyo street traffic to outmaneuver rivals.
feats.citation: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift (2006)

feats.claim: Participates in precision heists and vehicular ambushes across multiple international locations.

notableResults.note: Caught in an engineered car crash orchestrated by Deckard Shaw.

campaignTags.claim: Expert driver who handles high-performance customized vehicles in complex street chases.

unknowns: Exact details of his undercover survival after Tokyo Drift prior to his return in F9.

characters.summary: Hans Gruber is a brilliant, cold-blooded intellectual terrorist leader who relies on meticulous planning, psychological manipulation, and armed mercenaries to execute high-stakes heists.

mechanisms: Deception and acting as a civilian hostage

weaknesses: Physically unequipped for direct hand-to-hand combat against trained operators
Overconfident in intellectual superiority
limitations: Relies on henchmen and planning rather than personal combat prowess

sources.supports: Covers Hans Gruber's leadership of the terrorist takeover of Nakatomi Plaza and his use of firearms and tactics.

feats.claim: Seizes control of Nakatomi Plaza and locks down all communications and exits.
Successfully bypasses complex computer-controlled vault security locks using electronic code-breaking teams.

notableResults.note: Fell to his death from Nakatomi Plaza after John McClane unclipped his wristwatch.

campaignTags.claim: Orchestrates a sophisticated covert takeover of Nakatomi Plaza disguised as a terrorist/political group.

unknowns: Full extent of his terrorist network's international funding sources.
